title: Open the Code tab and give it a rule book

p: The <dfn>Chat tab</dfn> talks. The <dfn>Code tab</dfn> works inside one folder on your computer: it reads the files there, writes new ones and runs things. Everything you build in this course lives in the Code tab, so session 1 is simply moving in.

The first decision is the folder. One folder per job, never the whole desktop or the whole G: drive. For the Globus admin agent that means a folder holding only what the agent needs: course IDs, the rule book, later the skills. Stay <dfn>local</dfn> for now; cloud sessions need the folder on GitHub, and that is session 7.

A file called <dfn>CLAUDE.md</dfn> in the folder is read at the start of every session there. Think of it as the one-page rule book you would hand a new assistant on day one. Not for code; for the rules you keep repeating.

Checked against the docs: Claude Code also reads a CLAUDE.md in your user folder (rules for every project) and in every folder above the one you open; they are joined together, and each should stay under about 200 lines.
read.rule: If you have corrected Claude twice on the same point, it belongs in CLAUDE.md.

opts.c: A folder made for this one job

check.why: A standing rule you would otherwise repeat. Skills are checklists for one job (session 3).

build.where: in the Code tab on dell-js · 35 min

steps.p: Code tab → Open folder → create Globus admin agent inside Teaching – Globus. Local. Permission mode: Manual (you are learning, so you approve each file).

steps.pre:
Create CLAUDE.md in this folder: the rule book for an agent doing my Globus Language School admin. Numbered rules, plain English:
1. Courses are identified by Globus course ID (e.g. Beres_B_E_A005_26_04), never by student names.
2. Globus's figures on the Számlám page always win over any Sheet of mine.
3. In the Globus portal: SAVE, never FINALISE or SUBMIT. I review first.
4. Lesson serial numbers and planned dates are fixed; only the actual date changes.
5. Budapest time only. British English.
6. Before any portal step, state the course ID and lesson you are about to touch.
Then a section "What this agent will do": e-log entry after each lesson · training-plan updates · end-of-course reports · month-end invoice draft. Mark all four "not built yet".

steps.p: Open the CLAUDE.md it wrote. Add one rule it missed. Save.

steps.pre: Read CLAUDE.md and tell me the three things you must never do.
